scenes.headline: How Pele draws Mermaid diagrams without a browser
scenes.sub: Same syntax, a new parser, layout and writer
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Kindle! Pele is a new renderer for Mermaid diagrams, built for Obsidian. Here is how it draws them so fast.

scenes.text: Pele parses Mermaid text, lays the graph out in typed arrays, and writes an SVG string without ever touching the page.
scenes.say: The idea: parse the text, lay out the graph in plain arrays, and write the picture as one string, never touching the page.

steps.say: A hand-written parser reads the text. It is fuzzed against Mermaid's own grammar.
Labels are measured on a canvas, not on the page, and the layout runs over flat typed arrays.
Then the positions are written straight into one SVG string.
Colours are CSS variables, so a theme change needs no re-render at all.

scenes.title: The layered layout
scenes.say: The layout is the classic layered recipe, written from scratch.

items.say: Reverse the edges that close a loop.
Give every node a level, top to bottom.
Sweep up and down, reordering each level to cut crossings.
Then assign coordinates, and route the edges so they stay apart.

scenes.title: Two ways to draw the same text

left.title: Mermaid
items: Puts nodes in the page to measure them
Copies its whole config on every lookup
left.say: Mermaid measures text by putting nodes in the page, and it copies its whole config every time it reads a setting.

right.title: Pele
items: No config to copy at render
right.say: Pele measures on a canvas, has no config to copy, and escapes text as it writes.

scenes.title: Where a Mermaid flowchart render goes
scenes.note: Share of CPU samples, inclusive; rows overlap
scenes.say: I profiled Mermaid. The biggest cost is not layout or the page. It is copying the configuration object, over a third of every render.

scenes.title: How many times faster, by median
scenes.say: On the same diagrams, Pele was about a hundred to two hundred and fifty times faster by median, with a bundle six times smaller.

scenes.text: The speed comes from doing less per render: no page, no config copies, one string out.
scenes.say: The speed comes from doing less on every render. No page to measure, no config to copy, and one string out.
Parsers checked against Mermaid, a layout in plain arrays, and a string themed by CSS.
